name: Wireframe
description: A box drawn in wire: the front face, the back face, and the four edges joining them.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M10 30 H70 V90 H10 Z M30 10 H90 V70 H30 Z M10 30 L30 10 M70 30 L90 10 M70 90 L90 70 M10 90 L30 70; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M10 30 H70 V90 H10 Z M30 10 H90 V70 H30 Z M10 30 L30 10 M70 30 L90 10 M70 90 L90 70 M10 90 L30 70; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
